subject: tech
title: In and Out
about: Input and output: input is what we tell the computer (a tap, a key, a click, our voice, a photo) and output is what it gives back (a picture on the screen, a sound, a printed page, a buzz), then sorting real examples, with the touch screen as the part that does both. NC K2-CS-02 (what each part of a computer does). Read it together and act it out: point in at the tablet for input, then out at yourselves for output.
tip: Play the in-and-out game: you name a thing (a tap, a beep, a photo) and he points IN at the tablet or OUT at himself.

cards.q: When you tap, type or talk to a computer, what do we call that?
cards.note: Input goes IN. It is anything you tell the computer: a tap, a key press, your voice.

cards.q: The computer shows a picture or plays a sound. What do we call what comes out?
cards.note: Output comes OUT. It is what the computer shows you or does for you.
Typing puts letters into the computer. In means input.
The picture comes out of the computer for you to see. Out means output.

cards.q: You tap the screen to open a game. Your tap is an example of what?
cards.note: Your tap tells the computer what you want. Anything you tell it is input.

cards.q: The tablet buzzes in your hand. The buzz is an example of what?
cards.note: A buzz, or vibration, is the computer doing something for you. That makes it output.

cards.q: You say, play my song, and the song starts. Which part of that is input?
cards.note: Your voice goes in through the microphone. The song that comes out is the output.

cards.q: You take a photo with the tablet. The light coming into the camera is what?
cards.note: The camera takes in light from the world. That is input the computer turns into a picture.

cards.q: The printer gives you a page with your drawing on it. Which word fits?
cards.note: A printed page comes out of the computer. Out means output.

cards.q: Which part gives output you can hear?
cards.note: The speaker sends sound out. Sound you hear is output.

cards.q: You click the mouse on a picture. Does the click go into or out of the computer?
cards.note: A click goes into the computer, so it is input. The computer answers with output on the screen.

cards.q: The screen shows you a cat video. The screen is giving you what?
cards.note: Everything you see on the screen is output from the computer.

cards.q: A touch screen feels your tap and shows the pictures. Which is it?
cards.note: A touch screen takes your tap in and sends pictures out. It is input and output in one part.

cards.q: Which part takes in your voice as input?
cards.note: The microphone hears you. Hearing is taking in, so it is an input part.

cards.q: Here are three things. Which one goes into the computer?
cards.note: Talking, tapping, typing and clicking all go in. They are input.

cards.q: Here are three things. Which one comes out of the computer?
cards.note: Songs, pictures, printed pages and buzzes all come out. They are output.
